products.name: Thermocol Sheet — MD
products.description: Medium Density thermocol sheets ideal for packaging, crafts, insulation, display boards and general purpose use. Lightweight yet sturdy.

products.name: Thermocol Sheet — HD
products.description: High Density thermocol sheets engineered for structural strength, cold storage insulation, construction and heavy-duty packaging.

products.name: Foam Sheets
products.description: Premium quality foam sheets for cushioning, furniture padding, packaging and protective cases. Soft, durable and available in multiple thicknesses.

products.name: Thermorex Sheet — White
products.description: White Thermorex sheets with excellent surface finish. Used in signage, cladding, partition boards and display applications. Moisture resistant.

products.name: Thermorex Sheet — Black
products.description: Black Thermorex sheets for dark signage, backdrops, partition boards and premium display applications. UV resistant and durable.

products.name: Fevicol
products.description: High quality Fevicol adhesive for bonding thermocol, foam, wood and packaging materials. Strong, long-lasting bond.

products.name: Rubber Milk (Latex)
products.description: Rubber milk / natural latex adhesive for bonding foam, fabric and lightweight materials. Flexible bond, quick drying.

products.name: Tapes
products.description: Wide range of packaging tapes — BOPP tape, masking tape, double-sided tape and foam tape for all sealing and bonding needs.

products.name: Adhesive / Glue
products.description: All-purpose adhesive and specialty glues for thermocol, foam and general packaging materials. Strong grip, water resistant.

products.name: Clap Board
products.description: Corrugated clap boards in big and small sizes. Ideal for signage backing, packaging support and display boards.

products.name: Cutters & Knives
products.description: Sharp, durable cutters, utility knives and scissors for precise cutting of thermocol, foam and sheet materials.

products.name: Scissors
products.description: Heavy-duty scissors suitable for cutting foam sheets, packaging materials and thermocol edges cleanly.
